notes: כֹהֵן הָרֹאשׁ → 'the chief priest': attributive rendering (rule 28) with the fronted the on the rectum's article (rule 29).

חִזְקוּ וַעֲשׂוּ → 'Deal courageously' split across the two imperatives (courageously on חִזְקוּ, Deal on עֲשׂוּ) with the waw unrepresented; margin 'Be strong and do' corroborates and the noncompositional fusion of all three remains the competing reading.
דְּבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ → 'the king's matters' gives the the to the possessor's article (rule 29 possessive case); waw → 'also' under rule 51.
